places.name: Palaipafos and the Sanctuary of Aphrodite
places.intro: The ancient sanctuary of Aphrodite at Kouklia, part of the Paphos World Heritage property.
places.how: Drive east from Paphos toward Kouklia and follow the signs for the sanctuary and museum. Check village bus services before relying on a return journey.
places.before: Use the Kouklia sanctuary as your destination for the ancient temple. Aphrodite's Rock is a separate coastal stop. Allow time for the site and the museum if both are open.

places.name: Agios Nikolaos tis Stegis
places.intro: A frescoed Byzantine church outside Kakopetria, one of the ten Troodos painted churches on the UNESCO list.
places.how: Drive from Kakopetria to the signed church outside the village. Pair it with Panagia Podithou at Galata if opening arrangements allow.
places.before: Check opening times and the photography rules for the frescoed interior.

sources.t: UNESCO: Painted Churches in the Troodos Region

places.name: Agios Ioannis Lampadistis Monastery
places.intro: A riverside monastery complex in Kalopanagiotis with painted churches on the UNESCO list.
places.how: Drive to Kalopanagiotis, then follow local directions to the monastery complex by the river. Allow time for the final walk from parking.
places.before: Ask about the approach if anyone in your group needs a step-free visit.

sources.t: UNESCO: Painted Churches in the Troodos Region

places.name: Panagia Phorviotissa (Asinou)
places.intro: A painted church in the hills beyond Nikitari, known simply as Asinou.
places.how: Drive to Nikitari and continue to the signed Asinou church beyond the village.
places.before: Search for Asinou as well as the formal church name.

sources.t: UNESCO: Painted Churches in the Troodos Region

places.name: Panagia tou Araka
places.intro: A painted church outside Lagoudera in the Pitsilia hills.
places.how: Drive into the Lagoudera area and follow local signs for the church. Pair it with Stavros tou Agiasmati if both can be visited the same day.
places.before: Confirm interior access before driving between villages.

sources.t: UNESCO: Painted Churches in the Troodos Region

places.name: Panagia tou Moutoulla
places.intro: A small painted church in Moutoullas, in the Marathasa Valley.
places.how: Approach through the Marathasa Valley and navigate to the church in Moutoullas. Combine with Kalopanagiotis if timing allows.
places.before: Confirm opening and the final approach from parking.

sources.t: UNESCO: Painted Churches in the Troodos Region

places.name: Archangelos Michael Church, Pedoulas
places.intro: A painted church within Pedoulas village.
places.how: Drive to Pedoulas and follow directions to the church within the village. Allow time to park and walk the last section.
places.before: Use Pedoulas in your map search to find the right church.

sources.t: UNESCO: Painted Churches in the Troodos Region

places.name: Timios Stavros Church, Pelendri
places.intro: The painted Church of the Holy Cross in Pelendri.
places.how: Approach Pelendri from the Limassol or Troodos side, depending on your base, and navigate to the church in the village.
places.before: Use Pelendri in your search. Omodos has a similarly named monastery.

sources.t: UNESCO: Painted Churches in the Troodos Region

places.name: Panagia Podithou
places.intro: A painted church at Galata, a short drive from Kakopetria.
places.how: Drive to Galata and follow the signs to Panagia Podithou. Pair it with Kakopetria on the same outing.
places.before: Confirm access and any keyholder arrangements.

sources.t: UNESCO: Painted Churches in the Troodos Region

places.name: Stavros tou Agiasmati
places.intro: A painted church in the countryside outside Platanistasa.
places.how: Drive toward Platanistasa and follow the signs to the church outside the village. Allow extra time for the final rural road.
places.before: Confirm access before pairing it with Panagia tou Araka at Lagoudera.

sources.t: UNESCO: Painted Churches in the Troodos Region

places.name: Metamorfosis tou Sotiros (Ayia Sotira), Palaichori
places.intro: The painted Church of the Transfiguration of the Saviour in Palaichori.
places.how: Approach via the Palaichori area and use the full church name in your map. Walk the final section if village parking requires it.
places.before: Also search for Transfiguration of the Saviour, Palaichori.

sources.t: UNESCO: Painted Churches in the Troodos Region

places.name: Maa-Palaiokastro
places.intro: An archaeological site on the headland at Coral Bay.
places.how: Drive to Coral Bay and use the archaeological site as your destination. By bus, check Pafos Buses route 615 and the walk from the stop.
places.before: Confirm the entrance and museum opening before adding it to a beach day.

places.name: Agios Georgios Archaeological Site
places.intro: Excavations on the coast at Agios Georgios, beyond Coral Bay.
places.how: Drive beyond Coral Bay toward Agios Georgios and follow the local archaeological signs. Check bus connections from Coral Bay if you have no car.
places.before: Map results also show the church and the little harbour, so pick the excavations.

places.name: Kourion Archaeological Site
places.loc: Clifftop near Episkopi, west of Limassol
places.intro: The theatre, mosaics and ruins of ancient Kourion, on the cliff above the beach.
places.how: Drive west toward Episkopi and follow the signs for the archaeological site. If you take a bus to Kourion Beach, check the uphill approach separately.
places.before: Pair it with the Sanctuary of Apollo Hylates and the Kourion Museum when they're open.

places.name: Sanctuary of Apollo Hylates
places.intro: An ancient sanctuary west of Kourion, with its own entrance.
places.how: Drive west from Kourion and follow the signs to the sanctuary's separate entrance.
places.before: Allow a separate stop and check its own closing time.

places.name: Kolossi Castle
places.intro: A medieval castle in Kolossi village.
places.how: Drive from Limassol toward Kolossi and use the castle entrance as your destination.
places.before: Pair it with Kourion on the same day. Check the steps before planning an interior visit.

places.name: Kourion Archaeological Museum
places.intro: The local archaeological museum for Kourion, in Episkopi village.
places.how: Navigate to the museum in Episkopi village before or after visiting the hilltop ruins.
places.before: Check the museum's opening times separately from the site.

places.name: Amathous Archaeological Site
places.loc: Agios Tychonas coast, east of Limassol
places.intro: The ancient city of Amathous on the coast east of Limassol.
places.how: Follow the coastal road east from Limassol toward Agios Tychonas and use the archaeological site, not the beach, as your destination.
places.before: If you come by coastal bus, check the nearest stop and the walk to the gate.

places.name: Ancient Kition
places.intro: Remains of ancient Kition inside Larnaca city.
places.how: Search for the public Kition archaeological entrance and confirm the current access point before you go.
places.before: Use Kition with Larnaca in your search and check opening before planning a visit.

places.name: Kalavasos-Tenta
places.intro: A Neolithic settlement near Kalavasos, easy to spot by its large protective roof.
places.how: Leave the A1 motorway toward Kalavasos and follow the site signs to the separate Tenta stop.
places.before: Check access before pairing it with Choirokoitia.

places.name: Idalion Archaeological Site
places.intro: The ancient city kingdom of Idalion at Dali.
places.how: Drive southeast from Nicosia toward Dali. Check which entrance serves the archaeological site and museum on your visit date.
places.before: Search for both Dali and Idalion.

places.name: Tamassos Archaeological Site
places.intro: The ancient site of Tamassos at Politiko.
places.how: Drive southwest from Nicosia toward Politiko and follow the local site directions.
places.before: Check public access and opening before adding it to an inland day.

places.name: Makronissos Tombs
places.loc: Headland by Makronissos Beach, Ayia Napa
places.intro: Rock-cut tombs on the headland beside Makronissos Beach.
places.how: Head west from central Ayia Napa toward Makronissos Beach. From the beach access, follow the signed approach to the tombs.
places.before: It's an outdoor site, so check the walking surface before you go.

places.name: Kykkos Monastery
places.intro: The best-known monastery in Cyprus, high in the western Troodos.
places.how: Drive the signed mountain roads to Kykkos. Use a separate destination for Throni if you include it.
places.before: Check the monastery and museum hours separately.

places.name: Machairas Monastery
places.intro: A mountain monastery in the Machairas forest.
places.how: Drive from the Nicosia side toward the Machairas forest and follow the monastery signs on the final mountain road.
places.before: Confirm public visiting arrangements around services.

places.name: Stavrovouni Monastery
places.intro: A hilltop monastery near Pyrga with wide views.
places.how: Turn off the Nicosia to Limassol road toward Pyrga and follow the signed hill road.
places.before: Visit Cyprus states that women cannot enter the monastery and that photography and video are not allowed. Confirm access before setting off.

places.name: Trooditissa Monastery
places.intro: A monastery on the southern slopes of Troodos.
places.how: Drive from the Platres or Prodromos side and follow the signed mountain approach.
places.before: Check which areas are open to visitors on the day.

places.name: Trikoukkia Monastery
places.intro: A small monastery near Prodromos.
places.how: Drive to Prodromos and use the monastery name for the final approach.
places.before: Confirm opening and entrance arrangements before going.

places.name: Timios Stavros Monastery, Omodos
places.intro: The monastery at the heart of Omodos, one of the wine villages.
places.how: Drive to Omodos, park in a designated village car park and walk to the centre.
places.before: Use Omodos in your search so you don't end up at the Holy Cross church in Pelendri.

places.name: Agios Neophytos Monastery
places.intro: A monastery near Tala with the hermit's Enkleistra cut into the rock.
places.how: Drive inland from Paphos toward Tala and continue to the signed monastery.
places.before: Check visiting arrangements for the Enkleistra and the museum.

places.name: Chrysorrogiatissa Monastery
places.intro: A hillside monastery near Pano Panagia, in the inland wine country.
places.how: Drive inland from Paphos toward Pano Panagia and use the monastery as your destination for the final approach.
places.before: Pair it with Pano Panagia and the surrounding wine villages.

places.name: Agia Moni Monastery
places.intro: A small monastery in the hills near Pano Panagia.
places.how: Approach from the Pano Panagia area. Confirm the access road and whether visitors are received before you leave.
places.before: Treat it as a separate visit from Chrysorrogiatissa.

places.name: Vasilikon Winery
places.intro: A winery at Kathikas on the Laona-Akamas wine route.
places.how: Drive to Kathikas and use the winery as your destination.
places.before: Check tasting times with the winery.

places.name: Sterna Winery
places.intro: A winery and wine museum in Kathikas.
places.how: Drive to Kathikas, then navigate to Sterna by name.
places.before: Confirm whether a tasting or tour is available on your dates.

places.name: Vouni Panayia Winery
places.intro: A winery in Pano Panagia, on the Vouni Panagias-Ambelitis wine route.
places.how: Drive inland to Pano Panagia and navigate directly to the winery.
places.before: Confirm reservations and tasting-room hours.

places.name: Nelion Winery
places.intro: A winery on the Diarizos Valley wine route.
places.how: Use the winery name for the final approach on a Diarizos Valley outing.
places.before: Confirm visitor access and tasting arrangements.

places.name: Oenou Yi Winery
places.intro: A winery in Omodos, in the Limassol wine villages.
places.how: Drive inland from Limassol toward Omodos and route directly to the winery before or after the village centre.
places.before: Check reservations and restaurant hours separately.

places.name: Tsiakkas Winery
places.intro: A mountain winery near Pelendri on the Pitsilia wine route.
places.how: Drive toward Pelendri and use the winery address for the final approach. Confirm arrival arrangements with the winery.
places.before: The winery publishes a visitor contact and opening information.

places.name: Kyperounda Winery
places.intro: A high-altitude winery at Kyperounta.
places.how: Drive to Kyperounta and route directly to the winery from the village approach.
places.before: Confirm whether tours or tastings are available on your chosen day.

places.name: Latchi Harbour
places.intro: The little harbour at Latchi, where boat trips to the Akamas leave from.
places.how: Drive from Polis to the waterfront, or check Pafos Buses route 622. For a cruise, use your operator's boarding point.
places.before: Confirm the departure point and return time with the boat operator.

places.name: Baths of Aphrodite
places.loc: Beyond Latchi, at the edge of Akamas
places.intro: A shaded pool in a grotto where, legend says, Aphrodite bathed.
places.how: Drive west past Latchi to the signed visitor area, or check Pafos Buses route 622 if you have no car.
places.before: Check the final walking approach and current access.

places.name: Blue Lagoon, Akamas
places.intro: Clear turquoise water off the Akamas peninsula, usually reached by boat from Latchi.
places.how: For a boat visit, navigate to your operator's boarding point at Latchi Harbour and confirm departure and return times.
places.before: Not to be confused with the Blue Lagoon at Cape Greco.

places.name: Avakas Gorge
places.loc: Akamas foothills, beyond Pegeia's west coast
places.intro: A narrow limestone gorge in the Akamas foothills.
places.how: Use the signed access from the Agios Georgios and Avakas area. Check current road and trail information before you leave.
places.before: Plan it as its own outing, follow local notices and check the walk suits your group.

notice.t: The Department of Forests closed the Avakas Gorge trail for safety, after falling rocks and landslides. It was still closed in May 2026 and we have found no reopening since. Don't enter while it is closed.

src.t: Cyprus Mail: Forestry Department not responsible for visitors to closed Avakas Gorge (6 May 2026)

places.name: Limassol Old Port
places.intro: Limassol's restored old port, between the marina and the old town.
places.how: Navigate to the Old Port and walk toward the old town or the Molos promenade from there.
places.before: Pick a specific museum, restaurant or car park as your next stop.

places.name: Cyprus Museum
places.intro: The island's main archaeology museum, in central Nicosia.
places.how: Navigate to the museum, or walk from the central bus area around Solomos Square.
places.before: Check opening times and allow time for the archaeology collections.

places.name: Famagusta Gate
places.loc: Eastern side of Nicosia's walled old town
places.intro: A historic gate in Nicosia's Venetian walls, often used for cultural events.
places.how: Walk through the old town or navigate to the gate by name. Check any events inside separately.
places.before: Include Nicosia in your map search.

places.name: Laiki Geitonia
places.intro: A pedestrian quarter of restored houses, cafés and shops in Nicosia's old town.
places.how: Walk from Eleftheria Square into the old town and use Laiki Geitonia as your waypoint.
places.before: Pair it with the nearby museums and the old-town streets.

places.name: Kakopetria Old Village
places.intro: A preserved old village of stone houses in the Solea Valley.
places.how: Drive up the Solea Valley to Kakopetria, use the designated car park and walk into the old village.
places.before: Pair it with Agios Nikolaos tis Stegis, which has its own church pin.

places.name: Kalopanagiotis
places.intro: A hillside village in the Marathasa Valley.
places.how: Drive into Kalopanagiotis on the signed mountain roads and park near the part of the village you want to see.
places.before: The riverside Lampadistis monastery is a separate stop.

places.name: Platres
places.intro: A mountain resort village on the southern slopes of Troodos.
places.how: Drive inland from Limassol toward Pano Platres, or approach from Troodos Square.
places.before: If you add a walk, use a specific trailhead and check current route conditions.

kato-paphos.how: Walk from the harbour promenade to the park entrance. From elsewhere in town, start from Paphos Harbour Station.
kato-paphos.before: Start with the villa mosaics if your time is short, and choose your priority sites before you go in. Paths are exposed to the sun.

tombs-kings.loc: Tombs of the Kings Avenue, north of the harbour
tombs-kings.how: Go to the separate ticket entrance on Tombs of the Kings Avenue. Check Pafos Buses for the nearest stop from your hotel.
tombs-kings.before: The ground is uneven, with steps and open sun. The mosaics in Kato Paphos have a different entrance.

paphos-castle.loc: End of the Paphos Harbour promenade
paphos-castle.how: Walk along the harbour waterfront to the castle at the end of the promenade.
paphos-castle.before: Check whether the interior is open, separately from the waterfront. The archaeological park has its own entrance.

choirokoitia.how: From the A1 motorway between Larnaca and Limassol, follow the signs for the archaeological site, not the village centre.
choirokoitia.before: See the Neolithic settlement and reconstructed round houses. Check how much of the hillside route suits your group.

napa-monastery.loc: Central Ayia Napa, by the town square
napa-monastery.how: Walk from the centre. From the coastal hotel strip, use the square as your arrival point.
napa-monastery.before: Check which parts of the complex and any museum are open.

st-lazarus.how: Walk inland from Finikoudes to the church square. Use the square as your target by car or taxi.

hala-sultan.loc: West side of Larnaca Salt Lake, near the airport
hala-sultan.how: Drive or take a taxi from Larnaca on the signed Salt Lake approach. Check the walking route separately if you're on foot.
hala-sultan.before: An active place of worship. Check dress and access information before entering.

cape-greco.how: Drive from either resort, but pick a specific stop such as the sea caves, a viewpoint or Agioi Anargyroi Chapel before you set off.
cape-greco.before: It's a wide park, not one place. A general park pin won't take you to the viewpoint you want.

profitis-ilias.how: Approach from Protaras and head for the steps at the bottom of the chapel hill. Check parking separately.
profitis-ilias.before: The visit involves steps up to the hilltop.

konnos.how: Drive down the signed beach road, or check the nearest bus stop and the final walk.
konnos.before: The last part of the approach is steep. Step-free access isn't confirmed.

deryneia.how: Drive inland from Paralimni. By bus, check OSEA for your date and the return journey.
deryneia.before: Use a specific museum or the village square as your map destination.

aphrodite-rock.loc: Coast east of Paphos, beyond Kouklia
aphrodite-rock.how: Follow the signs for Petra tou Romiou and use the signed visitor parking and pedestrian approach.
aphrodite-rock.before: Search for Petra tou Romiou. The Sanctuary of Aphrodite is a separate place, at Kouklia.

finikoudes.how: Walk from central Larnaca or navigate to the promenade.
finikoudes.before: Saint Lazarus is inland in the old town. Use its square as a separate waypoint.

salt-lake.loc: Between Larnaca city and the airport
salt-lake.how: Pick a signed viewing or walking point. Hala Sultan Tekke is a separate destination.
salt-lake.before: Water levels and birds vary through the year.

lefkara.how: Drive inland via the signed Lefkara turn-off, use the village parking and walk to the centre.
lefkara.before: Pair it with Kato Drys if you have time.

wineRoutes.how: From Paphos or Coral Bay, drive inland to Kathikas. From Polis, approach from the north.
wineRoutes.before: Start with one winery that confirms your visit and add a village lunch.

wineRoutes.how: Drive inland from Paphos using Pano Panagia as your main waypoint. Chrysorrogiatissa Monastery has its own pin.
wineRoutes.before: Check winery tastings and monastery access separately.

wineRoutes.loc: Salamiou and Pretori, inland Paphos district
wineRoutes.how: From the coast, follow the inland route toward Salamiou or Pretori, using booked stops as your waypoints.
wineRoutes.before: Don't rely on a village name alone to find a tasting room.

wineRoutes.how: From Limassol, drive inland to one cluster of villages. Omodos makes a good first stop.
wineRoutes.before: Pair one confirmed tasting with a walk or lunch in a nearby village.

wineRoutes.how: Drive inland from Limassol toward your chosen Commandaria village, using Laneia or Kouka as a waypoint.
wineRoutes.before: Confirm which producer can host you. Visits are arranged directly with each producer.

wineRoutes.how: From Limassol or Troodos, follow the mountain roads to the village hosting your tasting.
wineRoutes.before: Pair it with Timios Stavros in Pelendri if the church is open.

wineRoutes.how: Start from the city closest to your booked winery and add a village stop after checking journey times.
wineRoutes.before: Contact each producer for tasting information.
